name: Kick Product

sources.title: Kick Product homepage — 'Free Forever' launch platform, 3-step launch process
Advertise page — Product of the Month $20/mo, Review Blog Post $30, Custom campaigns

requirements: SaaS product focus ('Launch Your SaaS Product')
Free account required — sign up, no credit card per homepage
preparation: Product name, URL, description, category and pricing
Founder profile details (products are linked to founder profiles)
workflow: Sign up free at /auth/signup ('no credit card required')
Launch the product from your dashboard
Share the generated product page and profile page links
Track views/votes/engagement via the built-in launch analytics
watchFor: Homepage displays '40% OFF Advertising Packages — LAUNCH40' promo and paid placements ($20/mo Product of the Month, $30 review blog post) — all optional upsells, listing itself is free
Advertising checkout goes through Polar (buy.polar.sh) links
Marketing claims ('10,000+ founders', testimonials) are self-reported on the site — moderate expectations for reach
countsAsLive: Product page live on kickproduct.com, reachable from the Products listing, with view/vote analytics accruing in the dashboard
unknowns: Whether launches are manually reviewed before going live
Whether free listings get a dofollow backlink
Any weekly launch cadence vs instant publish (not stated on public pages)
